usual_approach.note: full-text pattern counts over 148 unique ultrasound studies (192 folders): conv3d 27, cnn_then_recurrent 24, convlstm 9, transformer_attention 8. ConvLSTM hits by snippet: the target; its later thesis version (doi-10.14232-phd.11818, 2023); a 2021-06 prior that predicts ultrasound images from lip video with the ConvLSTM of Zhao et al. as comparison model (arxiv-2106.11769); a 2022 review describing Zhao et al. (pmc-9689563-utitrack / doi-10.3390-diagnostics12112811); and [later] citations or related-work mentions only (isca-toth23-usadapt / arxiv-2305.19130, doi-10.21437-ssw-2023-36, isca-wen26d_interspeech, isca-sonkar26_interspeech). No prior ledger study maps ultrasound to speech with a ConvLSTM layer; the ConvLSTM tongue-motion prediction study the target cites (Zhao et al., ICASSP 2019) is not in the wiki.
